simple.meaning: גֵּרְשֻׁנִּי (Gêrᵉshunnîy) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a Gereshonite or descendant of Gereshon.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 13 times across Numbers, Joshua, 1 Chronicles, 2 Chronicles, beginning at Numbers 3:21. Its contexts include family, family line, commandment, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גֵּרְשֻׁנִּי (H1649).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: גֵּרְשֻׁנִּי (Gêrᵉshunnîy) / H1649 is traced through Numbers 3:21, Numbers 3:23, Numbers 3:24, Numbers 4:24 as a generated source-based concept entry.

timeline.evidenceText: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.
The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.
Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites.
“This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:

At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.
This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. Their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.
Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.
People with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of Yahweh’s house, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

Then the Levites arose, Mahath, the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah;

definitions.full: H1649. Gereshunni גֵּרְשֻׁנִּי adjective, of a people with article as substantive collective Num 3:21 , 23 , 24 ; 4:24 , 27 , 28 ; 26:57 ; Josh 21:33 ; 1Chr 23:7 ; 26:21 ; 2Chr 29:12 ; with article as adjective singular masculine 1Chr 26:21 ; 29:8 .
